name: What causes window frames to rot in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What causes window frames to rot in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window frames primarily rot due to prolonged exposure to moisture and lack of proper maintenance. In coastal areas like the Bay Area, high humidity, fog, and rain can accelerate this process, especially if the frames are not adequately sealed, painted, or if the original materials were not water-resistant. Poor drainage around windows, condensation, and leaks in the wall can also contribute to water penetration and wood decay. Regular inspections and timely repairs are crucial to prevent widespread rot.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window frames rot from prolonged moisture exposure, common in the Bay Area due to humidity and rain. Factors include poor sealing, maintenance, and drainage around windows.
